en: Black‑and‑white image showing a rural lakeside scene with a few wooden houses on a hillside. In the foreground there is a sloping field; behind it stand houses surrounded by trees. A large body of water and forested hills are visible in the background. A flagpole with what appears to be the Norwegian flag flies near the right side. At the bottom left, white text is printed directly on the image.
